parameters.name: AutoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.
- You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId.

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description:
The cloud disk ID.
- You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:
- When no value is set or the value is set to less than 10, the default value is 10.
- When the value is set to greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call [DescribeRegions](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describeregions) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
